remarks: Welcome Home to East Norwalk! This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect balance of character and convenience. Featuring pine wood floors, elegant pocket doors, and high ceilings bathed in natural light, this residence exudes timeless charm with thoughtful updates. Enjoy mornings on the inviting front porch, afternoons on the large deck, and evenings relaxing in the spacious family room. The level backyard is perfect for entertaining, gardening, or unwinding. Other highlights include a first-floor laundry room, a walk-up attic for endless possibilities, and a full unfinished basement for extra storage. Located in East Norwalk, this commuter-friendly location offers easy access to the Metro North Train and I-95, making your travels a breeze. Your dream home is waiting! Schedule your tour today and experience this light-filled, bright beauty for yourself.
